Nell's first baby, Joyce, dies.

Hugh marries Nell Harcourt.

Thirza at first says she is not going to keep Nell.

Isolde becomes engaged.

Edmund hates Dan Coyle.
Tessa is the youngest of the Carrow children.

Tessa is in love with Julian Treleaven.

Captain Saul's surname is Garrick.
Captain Saul keeps a life-book.
Captain Saul tells Nell about lost Margaret.

Agatha Sowerby is to move to Grey Shutters.

Belinda the Fourth will go to Boston to live with the Irvings.
Robin pushes Lucy headfirst into a mud pie.
Lucy is good and quiet.

Cressida Lindsay comes from Harborough, Nova Scotia.
Aunt Euphemia is proposed as the girls' housekeeper.

Opal Pettigrew believes she will soon be dead.
Opal Pettigrew dies.

Rupert Ashdown collects toads, bugs and frogs.

Grace Ashdown dares Edmund Carrow to ride a pig.
Mary Stubbs eats ravenously at the manse.
Mary Stubbs lives with Miss Winifred.
